newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians clash with Israeli troops over road.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians clash with Israeli troops over road.

text.p: Israeli soldiers on Monday beat Palestinians who tried to stop workers from opening a road for Jewish settlers through land claimed by Arabs in the West Bank, witnesses said.

Palestinians said the scuffles erupted when an Israeli bulldozer began ploughing through vineyards and almond and olive orchards to open a road from the settlement of Kiryat Arba to the Israeli-controlled part of Hebron.
"Palestinians tried to reach the bulldozer to stop it from working and about 100 Israeli soldiers tried to beat them back," said one witness.
An Israeli army spokeswoman said she was checking the report.

The witnesses said Kawthar Sallam, a reporter for the Palestinian daily al-Hayat al-Jadida, suffered severe bruises when soldiers dragged her by the hair over rough terrain after she tried to cover the scuffles.
Witnesses said she was taken in an Israeli military ambulance to a clinic in Kiryat Arba.
Israel handed most of Hebron to Palestinian authorities in January under a peace deal that left 20 percent of the city under Israeli control.
